## History

Shakespeare is a newborn baby born to [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). He is a healthy, ten-pound boy whose arrival brings immense joy to the household following a period of prior grief. Visited and admired by friends and family, he is named [James Matthew](../character/james-a.md) in honor of Captain Jim and [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md).

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P2](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0002), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P13](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0013), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P14](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0014), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P15](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0015), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P16](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0016), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P17](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0017), +29 more_
